Bookmark of this page has been deleted. US Market Indexes Lower for the Week Dow Jones closes at 25,520.96 February 02, 2018 | About: CVX +0% XOM +0% GS +0% AAPL +0% AXP +0% 
U.S. market indexes were lower Friday. The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at 25,520.96 for a loss of -665.75 points or -2.54%. The S&P 500 Index closed at 2,762.13 for a loss of -59.85 points or -2.12%. The Nasdaq Composite Index closed at 7,240.95 for a loss of -144.92 points or -1.96%. The VIX Volatility Index was higher at 17.24 for a gain of 3.77 points or 27.99%. 
For the week, the Dow Jones was down -4.16%, the S&P 500 reported a loss of -3.89% and the Nasdaq Composite reported a loss of -3.52%. 
Friday’s market movers 
The Dow Jones reported its worst weekly return in two years while Treasury yields continued to gain. The 10-year Treasury yield increased to 2.852% on Friday. 
Economic reports affecting market trading included the following: The January jobs report showed an increase of 200,000 jobs with the unemployment rate remaining unchanged at 4.1%. The University of Michigan’s Consumer Sentiment Index increased to 95.7 from 94.4. Factory orders increased 1.7%. 
In the broad market, energy, technology and utilities led losses. 
Small-cap stocks 
In small-caps, the Russell 2000 Index closed at 1,547.27 for a loss of -32.59 points or -2.06%. The S&P 600 closed at 943.49 for a loss of -20.43 points or -2.12%. The Dow Jones Small-Cap Growth TSM Index closed at 9,598.09 for a loss of -195.51 points or -2.00%. The Dow Jones Small-Cap Value TSM Index closed at 10,123.09 for a loss of -201.26 points or -1.95%. 
Other notable indexes 
Other notable index closes included the S&P 400 Mid-Cap Index at 1,917.74 for a loss of -39.51 points or -2.02%; the S&P 100 Index at 1,224.69 for a loss of -27.46 points or -2.19%; the Russell 3000 Index at 1,629.56 for a loss of -34.81 points or -2.09%; the Russell 1000 Index at 1,528.27 for a loss of -32.68 points or -2.09%; and the Dow Jones U.S. Select Dividend Index at 705.14 for a loss of -12.33 points or -1.72%.
